title: Bugfix batch 4
desiredOutcome: The release-tier CI run is green on Linux and Windows: every job pins its runner image, and gate-parity's SIGINT/trap cases run on Windows

tasks.title: Fix BUG-28: gate-parity's trap cases run on Windows

add: tools/gate-parity.py: (inline --selftest) return_trap_honoured over stubs that are not shell scripts runs on every OS, and an OSError from the program is recorded as a failed case instead of ending the selftest body

notes.text: The `gate` entry (audit-status --gate) is dropped from BF4.1 and BF4.2 by the owner's decision of 2026-10-20 ("Izbaci `gate` iz BF4 taskova (Recommended)"): its open-high-bugs condition counts BUG-27 and BUG-28, the very bugs this phase fixes, so no fix task could pass it. Every other step stays; the condition still holds the phase sign-off and the release, when both bugs are closed. The tool fault (the condition should exempt the bug the gated task fixes) is in the register.

tasks.title: Fix BUG-27: every CI job pins its runner image, and a floating -latest label is refused

add: tools/gate-parity.py: (inline --selftest) a workflow job whose runs-on is a floating *-latest label is reported by name, while an explicit image (ubuntu-24.04, windows-2025) is not
